mintAuthority.summary: ZARm uses StableTokenV2 with minting restricted to broker/validator paths; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay, MentoGovernor as sole proposer, open executor). BorrowerOperations is immutable.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)

controls.label: Mento Timelock (ZARm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, ZARm owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; confirmed Timelock (getMinDelay() = 172800); hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036...) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) = true (open executor).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, ZARm owner() resolved to the 172800-second Mento Timelock and BorrowerOperations was confirmed immutable. At block 72127033, the ZARm EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563b0...850e and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolved directly to the same Mento Timelock, which can replace mint-critical token logic after its two-day delay. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: cap or minter replacement runs through the enforced two-day Mento Timelock, the live full-composition Mento reserve feed provides continuous reconciliation, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
